part2CueCards.task: Describe a conversation that you remember clearly.
bullets: where and when the conversation happened
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain how the conversation affected you.

idea: Chọn cuộc trò chuyện giúp bạn hiểu một người hoặc quyết định
Nêu chủ đề mở đầu và lúc câu chuyện trở nên đáng nhớ
Kết nối điều bạn nghĩ khác đi sau đó

vocab.vi: chia sẻ ý kiến chân thật
nhìn tình huống theo cách khác
còn đọng lại với tôi sau đó

aid.grammar: Dùng quá khứ đơn kể cuộc nói chuyện và since then để nêu ảnh hưởng kéo dài.
aid.sample: A conversation I remember clearly was with my older cousin during a walk after dinner. I had been worrying about choosing between two study options and kept asking other people which one was better. My cousin listened without interrupting and then asked what kind of daily work I could imagine enjoying. That thoughtful question changed the direction of the conversation. We talked about my strengths, the subjects I liked and the practical differences between the programmes. My cousin did not tell me which option to choose. Instead, he shared how he had made a similar decision and explained that it was useful to consider both interest and realistic opportunities. I realised I had been focusing too much on what other people might approve of. The conversation was calm, and we did not need to reach a final answer that evening. Afterward, I wrote down a few questions to research and spoke with someone studying each subject. I remember the conversation because it helped me think independently rather than expect someone else to decide for me. Since then, I have tried to ask myself what matters before requesting advice. It was a simple discussion, but its effect stayed with me and made a stressful choice feel more manageable.

part3Questions.q: What makes someone a good listener?

idea: Tập trung vào người nói và hỏi để làm rõ
Không vội phán xét hay đưa lời khuyên

vocab.vi: dành sự chú ý đầy đủ
thể hiện sự quan tâm chân thành
tránh vội đi đến kết luận
nhận ra cảm xúc người nói

aid.grammar: Dùng rather than để phân biệt lắng nghe với việc lập tức đưa lời khuyên.
aid.sample: A good listener gives someone full attention and avoids checking a phone or planning a reply while the other person is speaking. Asking a thoughtful follow-up question shows genuine interest. It also helps to notice the speaker's feelings instead of judging immediately. Good listening does not always require advice; sometimes a calm response and a chance to explain are more useful.

part3Questions.q: Do people communicate differently online and face to face?

idea: Tin nhắn cho thời gian suy nghĩ nhưng thiếu sắc thái
Gặp trực tiếp giúp nhận ra ngôn ngữ cơ thể

vocab.vi: bỏ lỡ sắc thái tinh tế
trả lời vào lúc thuận tiện

aid.grammar: Dùng whereas để đối chiếu tin nhắn với cuộc trao đổi trực tiếp.
aid.sample: Online messages give people time to choose words and reply at a convenient time. However, it can be difficult to read tone or facial expressions, which may lead to misunderstandings. Face-to-face communication offers a real-time exchange and more non-verbal information, but it requires people to be available at the same moment. Many people choose the channel based on the topic and urgency.

part3Questions.q: How can people handle disagreements in a conversation?

idea: Tập trung vào vấn đề thay vì công kích cá nhân
Tóm tắt quan điểm đối phương trước khi phản hồi

vocab.vi: dừng lại trước khi phản hồi

aid.grammar: Dùng instead of + V-ing để khuyên tập trung nội dung thay vì công kích người nói.
aid.sample: People can handle disagreement better by keeping a respectful tone and asking for clarification before responding. It helps to summarise the other person's point, so they know it has been heard. Focusing on the issue instead of attacking someone's character makes a solution more likely. If emotions rise, a short pause can give both people time to think and find common ground.

part3Questions.q: Are conversations between older and younger people valuable?

idea: Hai thế hệ chia sẻ kinh nghiệm và cách nhìn mới
Cần tôn trọng khác biệt về hoàn cảnh và công nghệ

vocab.vi: chia sẻ kiến thức thực tế
tôn trọng nền tảng khác nhau

aid.grammar: Dùng both generations can để nhấn mạnh sự học hỏi hai chiều.
aid.sample: Conversations between generations can help people exchange experience and understand how daily life has changed. Older people may share practical knowledge, while younger people can introduce new perspectives or technology. Both generations can challenge assumptions, provided that they respect different backgrounds. These conversations are most valuable when people ask questions with curiosity rather than assume that one age group has all the answers.

part2CueCards.title: A conversation that changed my view

part2CueCards.topic: Something you would like to buy
part2CueCards.task: Describe something that you would like to buy in the future.
bullets: what you would like to buy
how you would save or pay for it
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain why you have not bought it yet.

idea: Chọn món đồ thực dụng bạn đang cân nhắc
Nêu cách bạn so sánh giá và tính năng
Giải thích vì sao sẽ chờ trước khi mua

vocab.vi: tiết kiệm để mua món đồ
so sánh các mẫu khác nhau
chiếc xe đạp đáng tin cậy
giúp việc đi lại hằng ngày dễ hơn

vocab.en: buy only when I need it
vocab.vi: chỉ mua khi thực sự cần

aid.grammar: Dùng would like to cho dự định, câu điều kiện để nêu cách tiết kiệm và hiện tại đơn giải thích vì sao chờ.
aid.sample: Something I would like to buy is a dependable bicycle for short trips around my area. At the moment, I usually take a bus or ask a family member for a ride, even when the destination is not very far. A bicycle would make my daily commute easier and give me more flexibility. I have not chosen a model yet because I want to compare safety features, frame size and repair costs rather than buy the first one I see. I am setting a spending limit and putting aside a small amount each month. If I find a good second-hand bicycle in safe condition, I would consider that as well. I would use it for local errands and perhaps ride to a nearby park at weekends. Before buying, I would check that there is a secure place to store it and that the main routes are suitable for cycling. I do not want to spend money on something that will be inconvenient to use. The purchase is not urgent, so waiting gives me time to make a practical choice. I think it would be useful for several years and might encourage me to be more active, but I will buy it only when the cost and safety both make sense.

part3Questions.q: What influences people's decisions when they buy expensive items?

idea: Giá cả, độ bền và nhu cầu sử dụng
Đánh giá, bảo hành và tư vấn từ người đáng tin

vocab.vi: cân nhắc sử dụng lâu dài

aid.grammar: Dùng often depend on và liệt kê yếu tố bằng along with.
aid.sample: Expensive purchases often depend on price, durability and how frequently a person will use the item. Buyers may compare the total cost, read independent reviews and check the warranty. Advice from a trusted person can help, although individual needs differ. Taking time to compare options reduces impulse decisions and makes it more likely that the product will remain useful after the excitement of buying has passed.

part3Questions.q: How can cities make cycling safer and more attractive?

idea: Làn xe đạp liên tục và giao lộ an toàn
Bãi đỗ chắc chắn cùng kết nối giao thông công cộng

vocab.vi: làn xe đạp có bảo vệ
bãi đỗ xe đạp an toàn
kết nối với giao thông công cộng

aid.grammar: Dùng cities can encourage cycling by để nêu biện pháp cụ thể.
aid.sample: Cities can encourage cycling by building protected lanes that connect useful destinations instead of stopping suddenly at busy roads. Safe crossings and secure bicycle parking also matter. If cyclists can combine a ride with public transport, longer journeys become more practical. Regular maintenance is important too, because broken surfaces can make a route unsafe. These changes may encourage people to use bicycles for short everyday trips.

part3Questions.q: Is it important for consumers to save money before buying something?

idea: Tiết kiệm giảm áp lực vay và khuyến khích cân nhắc
Một số vật dụng thiết yếu có thể cần mua ngay

vocab.vi: đáp ứng nhu cầu thiết yếu
cân nhắc mức độ cấp thiết

aid.grammar: Dùng it is sensible to save when để nêu nguyên tắc và ngoại lệ.
aid.sample: Saving before a purchase is sensible when an item is expensive or not urgently needed. It helps people plan a budget and avoid unnecessary debt. However, essential needs such as a broken refrigerator may require a quicker decision, depending on a person's circumstances. The key is to weigh urgency against cost and make a planned purchase where possible, rather than spend impulsively under pressure.

part3Questions.q: How can people reduce the environmental impact of what they buy?

idea: Mua món bền, sửa được và thật sự cần
Cân nhắc đồ cũ, bao bì và khả năng tái sử dụng

vocab.vi: mua đồ đã qua sử dụng
cân nhắc tuổi thọ sản phẩm

aid.grammar: Dùng by choosing và by repairing để liệt kê hành động giảm tác động.
aid.sample: Consumers can reduce their impact by choosing durable goods and repairing them before replacement. Buying second-hand is another option when an item is still safe and useful. People can also avoid excess packaging and reuse products for as long as practical. These choices do not remove every environmental cost, but considering a product's lifespan can help people buy less often and waste fewer materials.

part2CueCards.task: Describe a rule that you think is useful.
bullets: where people are expected to follow it
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain whether you think the rule should stay in place.

idea: Chọn quy định giữ nơi chung sạch hoặc yên tĩnh
Mô tả lợi ích cho nhiều người
Nêu cách nhắc nhở công bằng thay vì chỉ phạt

vocab.vi: giữ khu vực chung ngăn nắp
tôn trọng không gian người khác
áp dụng quy định nhất quán
ngăn xung đột có thể tránh

vocab.en: review it from time to time

aid.grammar: Dùng the rule requires people to để nêu nội dung, sau đó because để giải thích mục đích.
aid.sample: A useful rule at my local library is that visitors should keep conversations quiet in the study area. The library also has a separate space where people can talk in a normal voice. I think the rule is reasonable because students, readers and people working online need different levels of concentration. A sign explains the quiet area near the entrance, so visitors know what to expect before they sit down. Most people follow it without being reminded. If someone forgets, a staff member usually gives a polite request rather than immediately treating the situation as a serious offence. This approach keeps the space comfortable and prevents avoidable conflict. I have used the library to prepare for exams, and the quiet atmosphere helped me finish tasks more efficiently. The rule also shows respect for people who may have travelled there specifically to study. It should stay in place, but the library needs to make sure the quiet zone is clearly separated from the social area. Rules work better when they are understandable and applied consistently. In this case, one simple expectation allows many people to share the same building for different purposes, and that is why I consider it useful.

idea: Quy định giúp mọi người biết giới hạn và trách nhiệm
Quy tắc chung giảm tranh chấp khi nhu cầu va chạm

vocab.vi: bảo vệ an toàn công cộng
cân bằng nhu cầu xung đột
giảm tranh chấp có thể tránh
áp dụng công bằng với mọi người

aid.grammar: Dùng help people to và so that để nối quy tắc với lợi ích cộng đồng.
aid.sample: Communities need rules to set clear expectations and protect public safety. Shared spaces involve people with different needs, so agreed limits can reduce avoidable disputes. Rules are more likely to be accepted when they apply fairly and are explained in plain language. They should also be reviewed when circumstances change, because a rule that once solved a problem may later create unnecessary barriers.

part3Questions.q: How should schools respond when students break a rule?

idea: Tìm hiểu lý do và mức độ ảnh hưởng
Dùng hậu quả có tính giáo dục và nhất quán

vocab.vi: giải thích hành vi được mong đợi
áp dụng kỳ vọng nhất quán
hỗ trợ lựa chọn tốt hơn

aid.grammar: Dùng should consider before deciding để nhấn mạnh cần tìm hiểu trước khi xử lý.
aid.sample: Schools should first understand the circumstances and explain which behaviour caused a problem. A proportionate consequence can help students recognise the impact and repair any harm. Expectations should be consistent, while staff consider whether a student needs additional support. Punishment alone may stop an action briefly, but guidance is more likely to help young people make better choices in future situations.

part3Questions.q: Do laws always change people's behaviour?

idea: Luật có thể răn đe và thiết lập chuẩn chung
Giáo dục, khả năng thực thi và thái độ xã hội cũng ảnh hưởng

vocab.vi: thay đổi chuẩn mực xã hội
việc tuân thủ theo thời gian

aid.grammar: Dùng may influence nhưng not always để hạn chế khái quát; then nêu các yếu tố bổ sung.
aid.sample: Laws may influence behaviour by creating a boundary and discouraging harmful actions, but they do not always change attitudes immediately. People are more likely to comply when regulations are understandable, consistently enforced and supported by public education. Social norms also matter. A lasting change often requires several approaches, because a legal rule alone may not address the reasons people behave in a particular way.

part3Questions.q: When should a rule be reviewed or changed?

idea: Khi mục đích ban đầu không còn hoặc tác động trở nên bất công
Lấy ý kiến người chịu ảnh hưởng và xem dữ liệu

vocab.vi: đánh giá mục đích ban đầu
thu thập phản hồi từ người sử dụng
tạo ra kết quả bất công
kiểm tra bằng chứng hiện tại

aid.grammar: Dùng when evidence shows that để nêu điều kiện cần rà soát quy định.
aid.sample: A rule should be reviewed when its original purpose is no longer clear or evidence shows that it creates an unfair outcome. Authorities can collect feedback from the people affected and check whether the rule is still practical. Sometimes the wording needs clarification rather than complete removal. Regular review helps rules respond to new circumstances while preserving the protection or benefit they were designed to provide.

part2CueCards.title: A rule that helps people share space

part2CueCards.task: Describe a place where you can relax and feel peaceful.
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain why the place helps you feel peaceful.

idea: Chọn vườn thực vật hoặc khu ven hồ ít đông
Miêu tả âm thanh, ánh sáng và lối đi
Kể hoạt động giúp bạn chậm lại
aid.grammar: Dùng hiện tại đơn mô tả nơi và hoạt động thường làm; thêm which makes để giải thích cảm giác.
aid.sample: A peaceful place I like is a botanical garden on the edge of my city. I found it when a friend suggested somewhere quiet to walk after a busy week. The garden has several shaded paths, a small pond and signs that identify different plants. It is usually calmer on weekday mornings, when there are fewer visitors and the sounds of traffic are distant. I like walking slowly around the pond and stopping to read the signs. Sometimes I sit on a bench and listen to the water moving through a narrow channel. The place does not have dramatic scenery, but it feels carefully looked after and gives me space to think without being interrupted. I leave my phone in my bag for a while, which makes the visit feel like a real break. The garden helps me clear my head because I can focus on small details rather than a long list of tasks. I usually stay for less than an hour, so it is easy to include in an ordinary day. I value this place because it is open to the public and offers a calm alternative to busy shopping streets. If I have visitors from out of town, I would take them there for a gentle walk and a quiet conversation.

part3Questions.q: Why are green spaces valuable in cities?

idea: Cây xanh tạo nơi nghỉ và vận động
Không gian công cộng xanh hỗ trợ sức khỏe và kết nối

vocab.vi: cải thiện chất lượng không khí đô thị
khuyến khích hoạt động ngoài trời
hỗ trợ động vật địa phương
tạo bóng mát khi trời nóng
làm khu dân cư đáng sống hơn

aid.grammar: Dùng can provide và can also để nêu các lợi ích bổ sung.
aid.sample: Green spaces provide a place to unwind, exercise and meet neighbours without needing to buy anything. Trees offer shade and can support local wildlife, while parks may improve the feel of a dense neighbourhood. Their value depends on access and maintenance; a locked or neglected park serves fewer people. Well-planned green areas can make a city healthier and more liveable.

part3Questions.q: How can city planners reduce noise in residential areas?

idea: Điều tiết giờ hoạt động gây tiếng ồn
Tạo vùng cây xanh và thiết kế đường giảm tốc

vocab.vi: đặt giờ yên tĩnh hợp lý
quản lý tiếng ồn xây dựng
tham khảo cư dân địa phương

aid.grammar: Dùng planners could combine để nêu nhiều giải pháp phối hợp thay vì một biện pháp đơn lẻ.
aid.sample: Planners could combine reasonable construction hours with measures that reduce traffic noise. Slower streets, sound barriers and green buffers can make busy roads less disruptive. Residents should be consulted because noise sources differ between neighbourhoods. Planting mature trees can help, although benefits take time to appear. Rules need to protect rest without preventing essential work or normal community activity, so enforcement should focus on repeated and avoidable disturbance.

part3Questions.q: Should access to parks and gardens be free?

idea: Không gian công cộng miễn phí tăng khả năng tiếp cận
Phí nhỏ có thể hỗ trợ khu vườn chuyên biệt nếu có miễn giảm

vocab.vi: tài trợ bảo trì thường xuyên
bảo vệ khả năng tiếp cận bình đẳng

aid.grammar: Dùng should generally be free rồi phân biệt với một số khu chuyên biệt bằng while.
aid.sample: Public parks should generally be free because they provide shared space for exercise and rest, regardless of income. A specialised botanical garden may charge a small fee to support maintenance, but reduced admission or free community days can protect access. The important point is that people should have nearby green space that does not require payment for ordinary use by everyone.

part3Questions.q: How can communities protect natural places while welcoming visitors?

idea: Giới hạn khách ở khu vực nhạy cảm
Dùng lối đi, biển hướng dẫn và giáo dục môi trường

vocab.vi: bảo vệ môi trường sống nhạy cảm
đánh dấu lối đi quy định
giải thích quy định địa phương
theo dõi tác động môi trường
cân bằng bảo tồn với tiếp cận

aid.grammar: Dùng can welcome visitors while protecting để cân bằng hai mục tiêu.
aid.sample: Communities can welcome visitors while protecting sensitive habitats through marked paths, clear guidance and limits in fragile areas. Local signs can explain why certain rules matter rather than list prohibitions alone. Monitoring visitor numbers and environmental impact helps managers adjust their approach. Conservation and access can coexist when people understand how to enjoy a place without damaging the plants, wildlife or facilities that make it valuable.

part2CueCards.title: Somewhere I go to slow down
